# Daily Briefing — Saturday 13 September

Yesterday was a quiet one — no structured training, 7,066 steps, and you burned 2,405 kcal, which actually nudged just above your 2,300 target. That's fine for a rest day, but keep an eye on it.

The recovery picture is mixed. Your HRV dropped to 87ms against your 99–118ms baseline, and only 5.2 hours of sleep is the likely culprit. Resting HR at 52 bpm looks solid though, and stress at 31 is low. If today has a session planned, keep intensity moderate — don't push threshold work on compromised sleep.

Tonight, prioritise getting 7–8 hours above everything else. It'll do more for your fitness than any single workout. And hit your 175g protein today — on lower-activity days it's tempting to eat light, but protein protects your muscle mass while you're in a calorie deficit at 91.4kg. You've got this. 💪
